Looking at this question about whether tagmentation of cDNA has been assessed directly in the PCR mix without prior cleanup and quantification:

In genomics workflows, particularly with Nextera/Nextera Flex-type tagmentation protocols, researchers have indeed explored streamlined approaches. Tagmentation (simultaneous fragmentation and adapter tagging) is often combined with PCR amplification in a single tube. Researchers have assessed bypassing cleanup and quantification steps to simplify cDNA-based library preparation workflows, particularly in the context of single-cell RNA-seq and other cDNA-based applications.

[ANSWER]A[/ANSWER]
